services.name: Business Registration
services.description: Register a new Estonian limited liability company (OÜ). Adult applicants with at least €2500 share capital are auto-approved by DMN; everyone else routes to a civil-servant review queue.

services.name: Vehicle Registration
services.description: Register a vehicle with Transpordiamet (Estonian Transport Authority), with optional co-owner signatures. The vehicle is looked up from a curated catalog; adult sole owners of low-value (under €5k) older (10+ years) vehicles are auto-approved by DMN, everyone else routes to a Transport Authority review.
